criterion: recall@5 on the val split, measured BEFORE any arm ran
why_this_is_not_post_hoc_tuning: The embedder is the one retrieval component with no VidyaRAG value to mirror - VidyaRAG uses OpenAI text-embedding-3-small, which this project cannot use at zero cost. A choice had to be made either way, so it was made on measured evidence, on val, before any arm produced a number. The mirrored parameters (chunk 512/64, top_k 20->5, dense only) were NOT touched.

thenlper/gte-base.error: fastembed returned variable-length embeddings; numpy raised 'inhomogeneous shape' at (256,). Not investigated further - two candidates were enough to make the decision. Recorded rather than omitted.

rationale: recall@5 0.817 vs 0.795 clears the pre-registered 0.80 threshold, and recall@1 improves markedly (0.576 vs 0.500), which matters because the top chunk dominates a 5-chunk context. Costs 2.6x embedding time, which is a one-off index build.
